description: review verifies its own findings and reproduces what it confirms (the verify role is gone); repro-covered fixes skip the self-check; light tasks escalate to standard by themselves; lessons.jsonl per package; max_parallel defaults to 5
changelog: The verify role is merged into review: in candidates and sweep mode each reader verifies its own findings (CONFIRMED / PLAUSIBLE / REFUTED, at most 8), may run tests and builds and writes repros under <task>/research/repro/ (the driver commits them with its report); the driver dedups and prefilters, then sends CONFIRMED findings to fix and PLAUSIBLE ones to the mandate. A CONFIRMED verdict of a candidates or sweep reader needs a repro, exec (a script that fails on the current HEAD and passes once fixed, plus its command) or trace (two or more existing file:line steps); the driver reads one without as PLAUSIBLE and says so in the report. After a fix the gate runs every exec repro as REPRO-n, and when they cover every fixed finding and the delta is small the recheck self-check is skipped (task.json recheck_skips). A light task escalates to standard by itself on two consecutive red gates, an implement report Partial or Blocked, or at a green BUILD gate more than 300 changed lines or files in two configured packages (task.json tier_history; next --json escalated; task.py set-meta <task> tier_lock true opts out). arbor.py finish appends every CONFIRMED finding to .arbor/spec/<package>/lessons.jsonl (merge=union via .arbor/spec/.gitattributes), the scorecard lists categories recurring across tasks without a test or a lint behind them (advisory), and task.py seed-context digests the open rows into research/lessons.md. executors.codeg.max_parallel defaults to 5.

migrations.description: verify role instructions, merged into review in 0.9.1

migrationGuide: Finish or abandon any task in REVIEW/verify before updating; the driver no longer has that step. Run `arbor update --migrate` to delete .arbor/agents/verify.md (kept when you edited it: move your local rules into review.md, then delete it). Review .arbor/agents/review.md for local edits: in candidates and sweep mode it now verifies its own findings and writes repros under <task>/research/repro/. The codeg `arbor-verify` assistant and any `assistant_ids.verify` entry in .arbor/config.yaml are no longer used; remove them.
